wishes: Family Western for the Cinema collection; the agent chooses the set title. A sunny frontier adventure, warm and nostalgic; no guns or violence, no saloon alcohol. 3 variants.

variants.concept: Ranch Day: the cowboy's gear and the home ranch
variants.moment: A sunny day of chores and riding on a family horse ranch below the red mesas.

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A classic cowboy hat with a tall pinched crown and a wide brim curled up at both sides, made of smooth felt, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; the brim is drawn thick and solid.
cards.unique_detail: a bright red hatband tied in a small bow at one side
cards.main_colors: caramel-brown felt with a bright red hatband
cards.background: Sky-blue background with a smooth light-to-deeper blue gradient and a ring of small golden horseshoe shapes centred behind the hat (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The most recognisable Western icon; an everyday wearable for the first common card.

cards.name: Prickly Pal
cards.subject: A round, chubby barrel cactus with smooth rounded ribs dotted with a few small soft white spine tufts, sitting in a glossy glazed clay pot, standing on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above.
cards.unique_detail: one big bright pink flower blooming on top of the cactus like a little hat
cards.main_colors: bright green cactus in a glossy sky-blue pot, with a pink flower
cards.background: Plain warm orange flat surface and a smooth orange wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: The desert in one small, friendly prop; the playful name adds a smile and the card carries the warm lead colour.

cards.name: Chow Time!
cards.subject: A ranch dinner triangle: a big, chunky triangle of thick hand-forged dark iron rod with one open corner, hanging from a rustic iron hook, with its matching iron striker rod hanging beside it on a short leather thong; drawn thick and turned to its broad side so it fills the frame; it looks like the rustic dinner bell of a ranch cookhouse, not a thin shiny orchestra triangle.
cards.unique_detail: it hangs from a small iron hook shaped like a horseshoe
cards.main_colors: dark forged iron with warm bronze highlights and a brown leather thong
cards.background: Sunny yellow background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the triangle; bright daylight.
cards.why: The ranch's 'come and get it' dinner bell from every chuckwagon scene; a playful name and an open silhouette unlike the other props.

cards.name: Coffee Pot
cards.subject: A cowboy camp coffee pot of glossy enamel: a tall, straight-sided pot that tapers toward the top, with a short straight spout set high on the front (not a curved teapot spout), a looped side handle, a domed lid and a sturdy wire bail handle arching over the top, standing on a polished wooden tabletop with a soft reflection; soft natural semi-transparent steam rises from the spout.
cards.unique_detail: a small painted white daisy on its side
cards.main_colors: glossy cobalt-blue enamel with a white rim and lid knob
cards.background: Polished honey-wood tabletop in front of a smooth warm orange wall with a soft gradient; the wall clearly lighter and brighter than the wood; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: Camp coffee is the cowboy's breakfast staple; the blue enamel pot pops against the lead orange.

cards.name: Lasso
cards.subject: A cowboy lasso: a neat coil of smooth, thick rope with one big open loop held by its sliding knot, floating with a slight tilt; the rope is drawn thick and chunky so the coil reads as one solid shape.
cards.unique_detail: a red leather tie wrapped around the middle of the coil
cards.main_colors: golden-tan rope with a red leather tie
cards.background: Warm red background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the lasso; bright daylight.
cards.why: The ranch hand's signature tool: rope tricks, not weapons, carry the action.

cards.name: Cowboy Boots
cards.subject: A pair of tall cowboy boots with pointed toes, slanted heels and pull-on side loops, standing side by side on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above; no spurs.
cards.unique_detail: one big cream-stitched star on each boot shaft
cards.main_colors: chestnut-brown leather with cream stitching
cards.background: Plain fresh green flat surface and a smooth green wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: Boots complete the cowboy outfit with a tall, vertical silhouette unlike the round props.

cards.name: Saddle
cards.subject: A Western saddle with a high horn at the front, a deep seat, a raised back and hanging stirrups, resting on a simple wooden saddle stand on a polished wooden floor with a soft reflection.
cards.unique_detail: a bright red saddle blanket peeking out underneath, with one big cream diamond shape
cards.main_colors: rich brown leather with a red saddle blanket
cards.background: Polished honey-wood floor and a smooth violet-purple back wall with a soft gradient, wall and floor in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: The signature riding gear and the most crafted object in the kit, so it opens the rare end.

cards.name: Windmill
cards.subject: A classic ranch water windmill: a tall four-legged wooden tower with a few cross braces, topped by a big round fan of curved blades and a tail vane, with a round wooden water tank beside its base, standing on a wide band of golden-green prairie grass; low camera so it looks tall and heroic.
cards.unique_detail: a bright red tail vane
cards.main_colors: silver fan blades, a red tail vane and a honey-wood tower
cards.background: A wide band of golden-green prairie grass across the bottom, a few distant red-orange mesas on the horizon, and a bright open blue sky with a few soft realistic clouds; sunny midday.
cards.why: The landmark of every Western ranch; tall and airy against the solid barn and gate.

cards.name: Horse Barn
cards.subject: A big wooden horse barn with white trim, a gambrel roof, wide double doors and an open hayloft door showing golden hay, standing on a wide band of green grass and a packed-dirt yard; low camera, the barn big and central.
cards.unique_detail: a shiny horse-shaped weather vane on the roof peak
cards.main_colors: barn red with white trim
cards.background: A wide band of green grass and a dirt yard across the bottom; behind the barn, rolling green hills and a row of rounded green trees fill most of the backdrop, with a strip of blue sky at the top; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The heart of a horse ranch: a big, warm place card that sets up the homecoming finale.

cards.name: Ranch Gate
cards.subject: A tall ranch entrance gate: two thick upright posts of pale sun-bleached logs joined by a log crossbeam high overhead, with a dirt road running through it toward the horizon, standing on a wide band of sandy ground with tufts of grass; low camera so the gate towers over the viewer.
cards.unique_detail: a big shiny horseshoe hanging from the middle of the crossbeam, open end up for luck
cards.main_colors: pale cream sun-bleached logs with a shiny silver horseshoe
cards.background: Golden-hour sunset: a glowing warm orange sky with soft pink clouds above distant red-orange mesas; the gate itself stays brightly lit and saturated, never dark or silhouetted.
cards.why: The climax: coming home through the ranch gate at golden hour, the classic Western ending, kept bright; the horseshoe carries the motif.

variants.concept: Wagon Trail: a pioneer family's covered-wagon trek west
variants.moment: A pioneer family's covered-wagon trek across the sunny prairie, camping along the trail.

cards.name: Sunbonnet
cards.subject: A pioneer sunbonnet: a soft cotton bonnet with a deep rounded brim and a gathered back, with long ribbon ties, floating empty in three-quarter view with a slight tilt; the fabric is thin with soft natural folds.
cards.unique_detail: a big cherry-red ribbon bow tied under the brim
cards.main_colors: sky-blue cotton with a white ruffled brim edge and a cherry-red ribbon
cards.background: Sunny yellow background with a smooth gradient and a ring of small brown wooden wagon wheels, each with a rim, a hub and thick spokes, centred behind the bonnet (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The pioneer family's everyday wear; it says 'frontier family' at once and keeps the set gentle.

cards.name: Flapjacks
cards.subject: A tall stack of fluffy golden pancakes on a round enamel camp plate, with a pat of butter melting on top and rich amber syrup running down the sides, standing on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above.
cards.unique_detail: a little tin fork standing up in the top of the stack
cards.main_colors: golden pancakes with amber syrup on a blue enamel plate
cards.background: Plain warm red flat surface and a smooth red wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: Trail breakfast from the camp skillet, with a playful cowboy name.

cards.name: Canteen
cards.subject: A round, flat trail canteen with a wool blanket cover, a short metal neck with a screw cap, and a leather carrying strap looping above it, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view.
cards.unique_detail: a little yellow sunflower patch sewn on the centre of the wool cover
cards.main_colors: red wool cover with a silver metal neck and a brown leather strap
cards.background: Sunny yellow background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the canteen; bright daylight.
cards.why: Water for the long trail: the small carried prop every Western traveller has.

cards.name: Sunflower
cards.subject: One big prairie sunflower head on a short sturdy stem with two broad leaves, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; the petals are a few big rounded shapes.
cards.unique_detail: a tiny red ladybug resting on one leaf
cards.main_colors: bright yellow petals with a chocolate-brown centre and green leaves
cards.background: Violet-purple background with a smooth gradient and soft concentric rings centred behind the sunflower; bright daylight.
cards.why: The prairie flower that lines the wagon trail; its sunny face echoes the yellow lead.

cards.name: Patchwork Quilt
cards.subject: A thick, soft patchwork quilt folded into a tidy stack, standing on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above; nine big square patches show on the top fold, with soft natural fabric folds at the edges.
cards.unique_detail: a big appliqued wagon wheel on the centre patch
cards.main_colors: sky-blue, cherry-red and cream patches
cards.background: Plain sunny yellow flat surface and a smooth yellow wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: Hand-made comfort packed for the journey: family warmth and nostalgia in one object.

cards.name: Travel Trunk
cards.subject: A sturdy pioneer travel trunk with a flat lid and smooth painted wooden sides, held closed by two wide leather belt straps with simple buckles, with a leather carrying handle on top, standing on a polished wooden floor with a soft reflection; it looks like old travel luggage, not a domed treasure chest: no brass studs, no metal corner caps, no padlock.
cards.unique_detail: a big painted sunflower on the front panel
cards.main_colors: cherry-red painted wood with brown leather straps and a painted yellow sunflower
cards.background: Polished honey-wood floor and a smooth fresh green back wall with a soft gradient, wall and floor in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: Everything the family owns rides west in this trunk: a signature pioneer prop.

cards.name: Trail Guitar
cards.subject: An acoustic guitar with a rounded body, a round sound hole and a long neck, standing upright on a small wooden guitar stand on a polished wooden floor with a soft reflection.
cards.unique_detail: a sky-blue bandana knotted around the top of the neck
cards.main_colors: cherry-red body with a cream sound-hole ring and a honey-wood neck
cards.background: Polished honey-wood floor and a smooth sunny yellow back wall with a soft gradient, wall and floor in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: Songs by the wagon: the trail's music, and the lead-in to the campfire climax.

cards.name: Rock Arch
cards.subject: A giant natural sandstone arch of smooth, chunky rock spanning a wide opening, rising from a wide band of sandy desert ground with a few round green shrubs; low camera so the arch looks huge.
cards.unique_detail: two dusty wagon-wheel tracks curving through the arch
cards.main_colors: red-orange sandstone
cards.background: A wide band of sandy desert ground across the bottom; behind and through the arch, a bright open blue sky with a few soft realistic clouds; sunny midday.
cards.why: The great landmark on the trail west: a big, warm place card for the rare end.

cards.name: Starry Camp
cards.subject: A trail campfire: a small crackling fire of crossed logs inside a ring of round stones, with a cast-iron cooking pot hanging from a simple three-legged tripod over it, on a wide band of grassy ground; low camera, the campfire big and central.
cards.unique_detail: a cosy rolled-up red bedroll resting beside the fire
cards.main_colors: warm orange flames, grey stones and a black pot
cards.background: Night: a clear deep-blue sky with a few big bright stars above soft rolling hills; the campfire, pot and stones stay brightly lit and saturated; the flames glow within the fire only, with no halo on the sky; never murky or dark.
cards.why: Evening by the fire is the warm heart of every trail story: the one deliberate night card, kept bright.

cards.name: Covered Wagon
cards.subject: A pioneer covered wagon with a big rounded canvas cover stretched over hoops, a wooden wagon box and four big spoked wheels, standing on a wide dirt trail through prairie grass, with no animals hitched; low camera, the wagon big, central and heroic.
cards.unique_detail: a cheerful sunflower tucked into the front hoop of the canvas
cards.main_colors: white canvas, a red wagon box and yellow wheels
cards.background: A wide band of dirt trail and green prairie grass across the bottom; behind the wagon, rolling green hills and a row of leafy green cottonwood trees fill most of the backdrop, with a strip of bright blue sky at the top; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The climax and the icon of the frontier journey: the family's wagon rolling west.

variants.concept: Frontier Town: market day on Main Street
variants.moment: A sunny market day on the main street of a friendly little frontier town.

cards.name: Mail Pouch
cards.subject: A frontier mail pouch: a chunky leather satchel with a rounded flap, a brass buckle and a shoulder strap, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; one blank white envelope peeks out from under the flap, with no writing or marks.
cards.unique_detail: a little sky-blue bandana knotted around the strap
cards.main_colors: warm brown leather with a brass buckle and a white envelope
cards.background: Soft rosy-pink background with a smooth gradient and small light-green cactus shapes repeated in a ring centred behind the pouch (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The mail rider's pouch brings news to town: a small, carried everyday prop to open the set.

cards.name: Prize Pie
cards.subject: A golden apple pie with a plump fluted crust and a few big leaf-shaped steam vents, in a round pie dish, standing on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above; soft natural semi-transparent steam rises from the vents.
cards.unique_detail: a big blue prize rosette ribbon, blank with no text, leaning against the dish
cards.main_colors: golden-brown crust in a cream pie dish, with a blue rosette
cards.background: Plain warm red flat surface and a smooth red wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: The market-day baking contest: a homey treat with a playful name, and the first card in the lead red.

cards.name: Pickle Barrel
cards.subject: A general-store pickle barrel: a chunky wooden barrel with two iron hoops, its round lid propped against the side, filled to the top with a few big bright green pickles, standing on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above.
cards.unique_detail: one giant pickle sticking up out of the barrel at a jaunty angle
cards.main_colors: chestnut-brown wood, dark iron hoops and bright green pickles
cards.background: Plain sunny yellow flat surface and a smooth yellow wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: The general store's famous barrel: a funny, nostalgic everyday prop.

cards.name: Lucky Horseshoe
cards.subject: A big, chunky horseshoe of polished steel, open end up, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; drawn thick so it reads as a solid shape, with a few large round nail holes.
cards.unique_detail: a sky-blue ribbon tied in a bow at the top of the curve
cards.main_colors: bright polished silver steel with a sky-blue ribbon
cards.background: Warm red background with a smooth gradient, bold radiating light rays and small cream cactus shapes in a ring centred behind the horseshoe (the set motif); bright daylight.
cards.why: Fresh from the town smithy and hung over every door for luck: the classic Western good-luck charm.

cards.name: Hoedown
cards.subject: A fiddle with its bow: a glossy wooden violin with a curved body, two curved sound holes, a scrolled head and four strings, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view, with its bow crossing behind it.
cards.unique_detail: a small bright red ribbon tied at the scroll
cards.main_colors: glossy honey-brown wood with a black fingerboard
cards.background: Fresh green background with a smooth gradient and soft concentric rings centred behind the fiddle; bright daylight.
cards.why: Barn-dance music makes the town festive; the playful name says 'dance', not just 'violin'.

cards.name: Anvil
cards.subject: A blacksmith's anvil: a heavy, chunky iron anvil with a flat face and a pointed horn, set on a thick sawn tree-stump block, standing on a polished wooden plank floor with a soft reflection; the iron has bright, sharp metal highlights.
cards.unique_detail: a small blacksmith's hammer with a red handle resting on the anvil face
cards.main_colors: dark gunmetal iron with bright highlights, on a tan wooden stump
cards.background: Polished honey-wood floor and a smooth warm red back wall with a soft gradient, wall and floor in clearly different tones; no props and no fire; bright daylight.
cards.why: The town smithy shoes every horse on Main Street; the heaviest, most solid silhouette in the set.

cards.name: Cash Register
cards.subject: An antique shop cash register of gleaming brass with a rounded, softly curved body and no engraving, two rows of a few big round keys, a small drawer at the bottom and a rounded top display panel, standing on a polished wooden shop counter with a soft reflection; all keys and the display are blank, with no numbers or text.
cards.unique_detail: a big round crank handle with a red wooden grip on its side
cards.main_colors: gleaming brass with cream keys
cards.background: Polished dark-honey wooden counter and a smooth violet-purple back wall with a soft gradient, wall and counter in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: The shiny centrepiece of the general store's counter: the rare, treasured object of the town.

cards.name: General Store
cards.subject: A frontier general store: a two-storey wooden building with a tall square false front, a porch with a plain red awning, a wooden boardwalk and big shop windows, standing on a wide band of sandy main-street ground; the board on the false front is blank; low camera, the store big and central.
cards.unique_detail: a barrel of shiny red apples by the front door
cards.main_colors: mustard-yellow wooden walls with white trim and a red awning
cards.background: A wide band of sandy main-street ground across the bottom; behind the store, a bright open blue sky with a few soft realistic clouds and distant red-orange mesas; sunny midday.
cards.why: Main Street's meeting place, where market day happens: a big place card for the rare end.

cards.name: Schoolhouse
cards.subject: A little one-room frontier schoolhouse of clapboard with white trim, a pitched roof, a small white bell tower with a brass bell above the door, big sunny windows and a few wooden steps up to the door, standing on a wide band of green grass with a dirt path; low camera, the schoolhouse big and central.
cards.unique_detail: a shiny red apple sitting on the top step
cards.main_colors: barn red with white trim and a brass bell
cards.background: A wide band of green grass across the bottom; behind the schoolhouse, big round green cottonwood trees and green hills fill most of the backdrop, with a strip of blue sky at the top; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The family heart of the frontier town; the apple and the bell make it a school, not a chapel.

cards.name: Steam Train
cards.subject: An old-time steam locomotive with a tall funnel-shaped smokestack, a big round boiler front with one headlamp, a cab and big spoked driving wheels, standing on railway tracks on a wide band of sandy desert ground; low front three-quarter view so it looks big and heroic; soft natural white steam puffs from the stack; no numbers or text.
cards.unique_detail: a bright red cowcatcher at the front
cards.main_colors: glossy red and black with brass trim
cards.background: A wide band of sandy desert ground and railway track across the bottom; behind the train, a bright open blue sky with a few soft realistic clouds over distant red-orange mesas; sunny midday.
cards.why: The iron horse arriving in town is the frontier's big event: the set's climax.
